# A chunk of fired clay (generated by make_env.py), 0.5 m, baked at its largest and scaled down.
new
material new Clay --base-color 0.6627 0.1922 0.1882 --no-slot
material new Inner --base-color 0.4784 0.0745 0.2196 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Chunk --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.25 --location 0 0 0
material assign Clay
active Chunk
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 4
select face where "normal.z < -0.3"
material assign Inner
mode object
select all
shade flat
export chunk.glb
